description: ACT-THREAD/ENGINE-IDENTITY on one STA: create DAO.DBEngine.120 twice and keep both; read Version and Workspaces.Count of each; append a workspace created on the first and read both counts; cause an OpenDatabase failure on the first (nonexistent work file) and read both Errors collections; release the first and read the second's Version and Workspaces.Count. Asks whether engine state is shared.
retentionNote: Designed r-str-ado-act probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
